baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural mountain object at word 1 and the causative R-S-W predicate at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun contributes an elevated solid mass while the verb makes its stability the outcome of an act. The clause foregrounds achieved emplacement rather than merely inherent solidity.

activation_trace.role: An elevated solid aggregation supplies the material body that is acted upon and stabilized.
Firm settling supplies the literal predicate and makes stability an achieved state.

changed_reading.before: The clause simply reports that mountains are fixed.
changed_reading.after: It presents elevated solid masses as deliberately brought into stable emplacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same mountain object is governed by a verb whose R-S-W inventory includes vessel mooring.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel-mooring branch recasts causative fixing as arresting possible motion at a station. The mountains remain literal, but their emplacement is imagined as mooring rather than insertion.

activation_trace.role: The elevated solid mass supplies the large terrain body that receives the mooring action.
A vessel stopped by its anchor supplies an arrest-of-motion analogy for the causative verb.

changed_reading.before: Fixing is an unspecified act of placement.
changed_reading.after: The mountains are held at station as massive terrain bodies under mooring.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The J-B-L object can denote hard terrain that stops digging, while R-S-W predicates firm settlement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hard-ground branch makes resistance to penetration part of mountainhood. Firming that mass creates a terminal substrate where downward cutting is stopped.

activation_trace.role: Hard terrain that defeats excavation supplies resistance as the mountain's operative property.
Firm settling turns that resistant material into a stable boundary in the terrain.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are objects that happen to be immobile.
changed_reading.after: They are stabilized hard stops whose resistance defines a material limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening field of uprooting, rapid pulling, and severe disturbance gives the later mooring image an opposing force. Mountain stability now reads as arrested displacement, not passive stillness.

activation_trace.role: The elevated solid mass supplies the body whose resistance to the kinetic field is being tested.
Mooring a vessel supplies the focus-side action that arrests movement at a station.
Uprooting something from its settled place supplies a direct counterforce to emplacement.
Rapid pulling intensifies removal and makes the later arrest of motion functional rather than decorative.
Severe disturbance supplies the destabilizing field against which firm stationing becomes salient.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 forms a cumulative movement sequence with repeated action forms.
79:6 introduces severe disturbance well before the focus predicates firm emplacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removal, rapid pulling, disturbance, and mooring; I infer an oppositional force relation in which the focus arrests that kinetic field. Alternatively, the earlier actions may have unrelated referents and supply only tonal contrast.

changed_reading.before: Mountain firmness is a static property.
changed_reading.after: Mountain firmness is an active counter-state to uprooting, rapid extraction, and disturbance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Excavation, hard bone, and decay activate the focus branch in which mountain-hard ground halts digging. The mountain becomes a resistant threshold set against both downward penetration and material disintegration.

activation_trace.role: The excavation-stopping hardness of mountain ground supplies the threshold at the center of this model.
Firm settlement stabilizes the hard threshold rather than merely describing its texture.
Digging earth downward supplies the penetration that the mountain-hard branch blocks.
Hard bone supplies a second solid material whose fate can be compared with mountain resistance.
Decay supplies material breakdown, sharpening the mountain as the contrasting non-yielding substrate.

structural_cues: 79:10-11 directly couples the H-F-R expression with hard bones becoming decayed.
The focus later combines mountain material with a causative settling verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excavation, hard bone, decay, and an excavation-stopping mountain branch; I infer that the focus presents a terminal material threshold. Alternatively, the H-F-R expression may function only as return-language, leaving the geological link dormant.

changed_reading.after: They are fixed resistance limits where penetration and material yielding are brought to a stop.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mountain is elevated yet assigned a stable place. Against transgression and arrogant elevation, its height becomes magnitude kept within measure: high without self-exaltation.

activation_trace.role: Elevated solid mass supplies genuine height without assigning it self-directed agency.
Firm emplacement makes that height bounded and assigned rather than self-asserted.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the unbounded mode opposed to settled elevation.
Arrogant greatness supplies self-exalting height, clarifying what mountain elevation does not do.

structural_cues: 79:17 marks Pharaoh with T-GH-Y, and 79:24 places the highest claim on his own tongue.
The creation sequence beginning at 79:27 shifts grammatical agency to the maker of sky, earth, and mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transgression, arrogant elevation, elevated mountain mass, and assigned firmness; I infer a contrast between self-exalting height and bounded height. Alternatively, the political narrative and physical creation list may remain independent domains.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes physical altitude plus stability.
changed_reading.after: It can also figure elevation disciplined by emplacement, in contrast to height claimed through transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The J-B-L branch of formed disposition meets contextual creation, composite structure, and internal completeness. R-S-W can therefore stabilize what mountains are constituted as, not only where they sit.

activation_trace.role: A formed innate disposition supplies an internal constitution for the mountain object.
Firm settling makes stability a secured feature of that constitution.
Inner disposition within creation activates the focus noun's constitution branch.
Composite built form supplies an engineered structure in which stability can be embodied.
Internal straightness and completion supply the design logic for constitutive stability.

structural_cues: 79:27 asks about difficulty of creation and opens the sequence that reaches 79:32.
79:27-32 repeatedly applies perfect verbs with feminine object pronouns to created domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disposition, creation, composite form, completion, and firm settlement; I infer that emplacement expresses designed constitution as well as location. Alternatively, the sequence may describe only external operations on already constituted objects.

changed_reading.before: The verb moves or fixes an already formed object from outside.
changed_reading.after: The act also secures stability into the mountain's formed constitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky is assembled, raised, and given a holding roof-like height; the mountains are then elevated masses brought to station. The focus becomes the terrestrial counterpart within a coordinated vertical architecture.

activation_trace.role: Elevated solid aggregation supplies the terrestrial mass in the vertical pairing.
Firm stationing supplies the complementary operation to the sky's upward construction.
Joining parts into a building supplies the architectural frame for reading the sequence.
Raising supplies the upward operation that mountain stationing later complements.
A roof that holds a building supplies the load-bearing image for the elevated sky.

structural_cues: 79:27-28 immediately precedes the earth sequence and uses build, raise, and height operations.
The focus closes the creation operations with another object-then-perfect-verb construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembled building, upward raising, a holding roof, elevated mountain mass, and firm stationing; I infer a paired vertical system. Alternatively, these may be parallel demonstrations of power without a counterbalancing function.

changed_reading.before: Mountain fixing is an isolated geological statement.
changed_reading.after: Mountain stationing completes a vertical architecture whose other pole is the raised, held sky.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mountain anchoring sits between the emergence of water and pasture and their declared utility for humans and livestock. Stable relief is read as maintained habitat infrastructure rather than scenic mass.

activation_trace.role: The elevated solid mass supplies the terrain component incorporated into the provisioning system.
Firm settlement supplies the maintaining operation that lets terrain function as infrastructure.
Bringing a concealed thing outward supplies the emergence process for the land's provisions.
Literal water supplies the life-supporting material associated with the prepared terrain.
Grazing pasture supplies the productive land use that the stable terrain serves.
Enjoyable practical benefit supplies the explicit purpose toward which the terrain sequence is directed.
Livestock wealth supplies a concrete beneficiary of water, pasture, and stabilized land.

structural_cues: 79:31, 79:32, and 79:33 form an uninterrupted water-and-pasture, mountains, and benefit sequence.
Possessive and object pronouns keep the provisioning operations tied to the prepared earth and its features.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emerging water, pasture, anchored mountains, benefit, and livestock; I infer that stable terrain enables and preserves usability. Alternatively, the sequence may list coordinate gifts without asserting a causal ecological arrow.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are a standalone display of stable mass.
changed_reading.after: Their anchoring is a load-bearing operation within a habitat prepared for water, grazing, and sustained use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question about the Hour repeats R-S-W in a temporal setting, and the answer assigns its endpoint to the Lord. The focus's spatial mooring becomes a concrete model for a fixed but inaccessible temporal anchorage.

activation_trace.role: The concrete elevated mass supplies the spatial body from which the temporal analogy begins.
A fixed mooring supplies a determinate station that can be transferred from space to time.
Questioning and seeking supplies the human demand to know the temporal station.
Sovereign mastery assigns control of the endpoint beyond the questioner's reach.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the temporal terminus corresponding to a mooring point.

structural_cues: 79:42 repeats R-S-W at word 5, ten verses after the focus verb, while asking when the Hour will be fixed.
79:44 answers the timing question with ownership of its endpoint rather than a date.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact R-S-W recurrence, a timing question, sovereign control, and an endpoint; I infer a space-to-time transfer from mountain mooring to temporal appointment. Alternatively, the later R-S-W form may be an idiomatic time expression without a sustained mountain analogy.

changed_reading.before: The focus verb only locates mountains in space.
changed_reading.after: Its spatial mooring also prepares the surah's image of the Hour as having a divinely fixed temporal station.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the overt object is physical mountains. It remains anchored because the focus verb has a report-securing branch and 79:15 explicitly introduces a report; downstream prose should mark it as metadiscursive resonance, never as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The R-S-W verb at focus word 2, specifically its report-securing branch.

activation_trace.role: Securing a report in memory lets physical fixing acquire a secondary mnemonic function.
A report renewed in speech supplies the discourse domain that activates the remote focus branch.

changed_reading.before: The mountain clause contributes only physical information.
changed_reading.after: Its concrete fixing can also act as a mnemonic anchor within a surah that explicitly frames the Moses episode as a report.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain analogy, not a lexical gloss of mountains. It remains anchored in the focus predicate of firm settlement and in 79:40's station, restraint, living self, and inclination; downstream prose should qualify it as a material model for ethical steadiness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative firm-settlement sense of R-S-W at focus word 2.

activation_trace.role: Firm settlement supplies the physical template for a self held steady.
A standing place or station supplies the accountable position that ethical steadiness holds.
Active restraint supplies the check that keeps the self from leaving its station.
The living self supplies the human body of the ethical anchoring analogy.
Inclination of desire supplies the lateral pull against which restraint becomes anchoring.

changed_reading.before: Mountain stability has no bearing beyond the physical landscape.
changed_reading.after: It can serve as a contained physical analogue for restraining the self against destabilizing inclination.

strongest_changes: The sky-building sequence recasts mountain stationing as the terrestrial pole of a vertical architecture.
The water, pasture, and benefit sequence turns mountain anchoring into habitat infrastructure.
The later R-S-W recurrence transfers spatial mooring into a model for the Hour's fixed temporal endpoint.
Pharaoh's transgression and self-exalting height activate a contrast with elevated mass held within an assigned station.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated one compact focus clause across material resistance, designed structure, ecological use, bounded power, and temporal determination while preserving literal mountains as the anchor.
remaining_uncertainties: The early extraction and disturbance vocabulary may create only tonal contrast rather than a functional opposition.
The provisioning sequence strongly frames the focus, but its causal direction from stable terrain to usable water and pasture is reader-supplied.
The spatial-to-temporal mooring transfer has an exact root recurrence, but the strength of the sustained analogy remains inferential.
The narrative and ethical outliers should remain qualified cross-domain resonances rather than replacement meanings.
